title: Additional sign regulations
previewText: Where illuminated signs are permitted by the underlying district regulations, such signs shall have only indirect illumination. Where signs, other than advertising signs, are permitted by the underlying district regulations, such signs shall not extend above the roof level of any building or other structure in the Special District.
